06Scope

Before we begin

These are starting prices. Your quote depends on the pages, features and content needed. The price and deliverables are agreed in writing before work starts.

Your domain (website address), hosting, paid plugins and outside service fees cost extra unless your quote includes them.

You supply the text, images, product details and policies unless content work is included in your quote.

Your quote states how many revision rounds are included. Extra pages, features or a change of direction are priced before they are added.

Every site gets security checks before launch. Accounts, payments and private data need additional checks suited to the project. Formal audits and compliance work are separate.

All prices on this page are in ₹ (INR) and exclusive of applicable GST.

07 / technical details

Technical standards.

Security, data and implementation details when you need them.

Included in ₹15,000+ projects

  • Simple forms + database
  • CRUD operations
  • Authentication
  • Admin dashboard
  • Search & filtering
  • Dynamic data · SQL / MongoDB

MongoDB

MongoDB is included at no additional charge for projects ₹15,000 and above. SQL or MongoDB — whichever fits the build.

User roles & file upload

Available for ₹30,000+ projects, added according to project requirements.

Add-on ₹2,000–₹5,000

Security before launch

HTTPS on supported hosting, secure handling of credentials, form validation and abuse protection, security headers, dependency review, and removal of test access.

Projects with accounts, payments, uploads or private data need additional authentication, authorisation and access controls. Formal audits and compliance work are quoted separately.
